feature.title: The richer Feature editor: fields, attachments, links
feature.goal: A Feature carries its goal, status, attachments and links in one editor.
feature.description:
The Feature editor grows from a title and description into the place a feature is run from.

## Contracts

**C1 — Feature fields.** goal, status_line, slug and started_on on the Feature, read and written by the API.

**C2 — Attachments.** list, upload, replace by name and remove, on the Feature.

**C3 — Links.** a link has a title, a kind and a target; the server resolves its preview.

**C4 — Editor shell.** one panel per lane, each loading its own data.

common_brief:
You are one implementer on the Feature editor plan, working alone in your own worktree.

## Rules

- Read your brief and the Contracts section of the Feature first.
- Commit small; push to the shared branch after each green step.
- If a contract is wrong, stop and report. Never work around it.

## Report

Report with report_task when you are done, blocked or partial.
